meta.title: Switch
meta.lead: A switch component in pure CSS, using the checkbox syntax.

blocks.label: Switch example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Switch example" class="component"><fieldset><label><input name="terms" role="switch" type="checkbox"/>I agree to the Terms</label><label><input checked="" name="opt-in" role="switch" type="checkbox"/>I want to receive updates</label></fieldset></article>
blocks.code:
<fieldset>
  <label>
    <input name="terms" type="checkbox" role="switch" />
    I agree to the Terms
  </label>
  <label>
    <input name="opt-in" type="checkbox" role="switch" checked />
    Receive news and offers
  </label>
</fieldset>

blocks.label: Disabled switch example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Disabled switch example" class="component"><fieldset><label aria-disabled="true"><input disabled="" name="publish" role="switch" type="checkbox"/>Publish on my profile</label><label aria-disabled="true"><input checked="" disabled="" name="change-password" role="switch" type="checkbox"/>Change my password at next login</label></fieldset></article>
blocks.code:
<fieldset>
  <label>
    <input name="publish" type="checkbox" role="switch" disabled />
    Publish on my profile
  </label>
  <label>
    <input name="change-password" type="checkbox" role="switch" checked disabled />
    Change my password at next login
  </label>
</fieldset>

blocks.label: Validation states example
blocks.demo: <article aria-label="Validation states example" class="component"><fieldset><label><input aria-invalid="false" name="2fa" role="switch" type="checkbox"/>Enable two-factor authentication</label><label><input aria-invalid="true" name="subscription" role="switch" type="checkbox"/>Automatic subscription renewal</label></fieldset></article>
blocks.code:
<fieldset>
  <label>
    <input name="2fa" type="checkbox" role="switch" aria-invalid="false" />
    Enable two-factor authentication
  </label>
  <label>
    <input name="subscription" type="checkbox" role="switch" aria-invalid="true" />
    Automatic subscription renewal
  </label>
</fieldset>
